name: Hurt Feelings
overview: Scripture encourages believers to respond to hurt feelings with trust in the Lord's protection and justice rather than seeking personal revenge, as God Himself will fight for His people and repay wrongs (Exodus 14:14; Romans 12:19). Christians are called to love and pray for those who wrong them, demonstrating kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness modeled on God's forgiveness through Christ (Matthew 5:44; Ephesians 4:32). In times of emotional burden, Jesus invites the weary to find rest in Him, assuring peace and hope for the future according to God's good plans (Matthew 11:28; Jeremiah 29:11).
